evidence:

worktree: "ls: goldens/*.md: No such file or directory" (no goldens README). manifest.odin:93 fixed format has no cause field: fmt.sbprintf(&sb, "t1 1\ndemo %s\nseed %d\nlogic_hz %d\ncatalog_hash %016x\nticks %d\n", ...). Only durable in-repo record found: commit 6f23b31 message "dublin_board T1/replay/T2 re-blessed with cause (map restyle)"
detail: Spec: "underlay goldens re-blessed with cause". Cause is durable only in the commit message/PR body; the .t1 header (fixed v1 format) and goldens/ carry no cause record — the artifact itself is silent.
recommended_fix: Optional: add a goldens/README (or a manifest v2 comment line) recording each deliberate re-bless cause + date, so the golden artifacts self-document.
